longDescription: ``xgsch2pcb`` provides an intuitive, user-friendly graphical interface to the ``gsch2pcb`` command-line tool, part of the gEDA suite, which is used to generate and update a PCB layout. It works with schematics created by ``gschem``, part of the gEDA suite, and layouts created by ``pcb``, a PCB layout system commonly used with gEDA.
